user_input: How long do I have to return an item I bought online?
response: You have 30 days from the delivery date to return most items for a full refund, as long as they are unworn and in the original packaging with tags attached.
retrieved_contexts: Returns policy: Most items purchased on our website may be returned within 30 days from the delivery date for a full refund. To qualify, items must be unworn, in their original packaging, and have all tags attached.
To start a return, sign in to your account, open the order, and select 'Return items' to print a prepaid label.
reference: You have 30 days from the delivery date to return most items for a full refund, provided they are unworn and in the original packaging with tags attached.

user_input: When will I get my refund after the warehouse receives my return?
response: Once the warehouse receives and inspects your return, your refund is issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
retrieved_contexts: Refund timing: After we receive your returned item, our warehouse inspects it and issues the refund to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
Refunds are sent back to the same card or PayPal account used at checkout; we cannot redirect a refund to a different payment method.
reference: After the warehouse receives and inspects your return, the refund is issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

metadata.note: retrieval HIT: contexts contain the inspection step, original-payment-method, and 5-7 business day refund window from the reference

user_input: Do I have to pay for return shipping?
response: Return shipping is free when you use the prepaid return label, but a 6 dollar 99 cent fee is deducted from your refund if you drop the package at a carrier without the label.
retrieved_contexts: Return shipping: Using the prepaid return label in your account is free. If you ship a return without the prepaid label, a flat 6.99 handling fee is deducted from your refund.
Each return is covered by one prepaid label; contact support if you need a replacement label for a damaged box.
reference: Return shipping is free with the prepaid return label, but a 6.99 fee is deducted from your refund if you return the package without the prepaid label.

metadata.note: retrieval HIT: contexts state the prepaid label is free and the 6.99 deduction without the label, matching the reference

user_input: Can I return a final sale or clearance item?
response: Final sale and clearance items cannot be returned or refunded, except when the item arrives damaged or defective, in which case you may request a replacement within 14 days.
retrieved_contexts: Final sale items: Products marked 'Final Sale' or 'Clearance' are not eligible for return or refund. The only exception is an item that arrives damaged or defective, which can be replaced if reported within 14 days of delivery.
Look for the 'Final Sale' badge on the product page and in your order summary before purchasing.
reference: Final sale and clearance items are not eligible for return or refund, except when the item arrives damaged or defective, in which case a replacement can be requested within 14 days.

metadata.note: retrieval HIT: contexts contain the no-return rule for final sale/clearance plus the damaged/defective 14-day replacement exception from the reference

user_input: How do I exchange an item for a different size?
response: To exchange an item for a different size, start a return in your account and place a new order for the size you want; the exchange ships once the original return is scanned by the carrier.
retrieved_contexts: Exchanges: We process size and color exchanges as a return plus a new order. Start a return in your account, then place a new order for the size you want. The replacement ships as soon as the carrier scans your original return.
Placing the new order right away reserves your size so it does not sell out while your return is in transit.
reference: To exchange an item for a different size, start a return in your account and place a new order for the size you want, and the exchange ships once the carrier scans the original return.
